title: 隐状态前缀长度
layers: 选定模块的输出隐藏状态序列
layers_en: Output hidden-state sequence of the selected modules

standard.summary: 在选定模块完成 forward 后，将可学习向量拼接到输出 hidden-state sequence 前部；0 表示关闭。这是 lulynx 工程 prompt，不是论文 Prefix-Tuning (arXiv:2101.00190) 的逐层 attention K/V prefix。
standard.effect: 控制 prelude 向量数量；可与 epilogue 同时使用，参数进入现有优化器与产物保存链。
standard.whenToUse: 需要用少量额外参数实验性改写已选模块的输出序列，并且训练与推理端都明确支持该附加状态时。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要论文 Prefix-Tuning 的逐层 attention K/V 注入语义、标准 LoRA 互操作，或下游严格要求原序列长度时。

standard_en.summary: After the selected modules finish their forward pass, prepends learnable vectors to the front of the output hidden-state sequence; 0 turns it off. This is a lulynx engineering prompt, not the per-layer attention K/V prefix of the paper Prefix-Tuning (arXiv:2101.00190).
standard_en.effect: Controls how many prelude vectors there are; it can be used together with the epilogue, and the parameters join the existing optimizer and artefact-saving chain.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to experiment with rewriting the output sequence of the selected modules using a small number of extra parameters, and both the training and inference sides explicitly support that added state.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need the semantics of the paper's per-layer attention K/V injection, interoperability with standard LoRA, or when downstream strictly requires the original sequence length.

advanced.principle: 实现通过 post-forward hook 修改已选模块的输出；不会为每层 attention 生成或注入 prefix key/value，也不能表述为论文 Prefix-Tuning。
advanced.intervention: 安装器选择现有模块并注册 forward hook，将 prelude 向量拼接到输出 hidden states 前部；仅在输出结构允许安全同步 attention mask 时扩展 mask，否则 fail-fast。
advanced.expectedImpact: 增加 length × hidden_size 个可训练参数；实际效果依赖插入模块、下游 shape 契约和推理端是否重现同一 hook。
advanced.tradeoffs: 产物包含 lulynx 专用附加状态，第三方推理端可能忽略；序列长度改变也可能与下游固定 shape 契约冲突。

advanced_en.principle: The implementation modifies selected modules' outputs via post-forward hooks; it does not generate or inject prefix key/values for each layer's attention and cannot be described as paper Prefix-Tuning.
advanced_en.intervention: The installer selects existing modules and registers forward hooks, prepending prelude vectors to the output hidden states; the mask is extended only when the output structure allows safe attention-mask synchronization, otherwise it fails fast.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Adds length × hidden_size trainable parameters; the actual effect depends on the insertion module, downstream shape contracts, and whether the inference side reproduces the same hook.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The artifact contains lulynx-specific extra state that third-party inference consumers may ignore; the changed sequence length can also conflict with downstream fixed-shape contracts.
